source.description: Expression for single-value binding, or dataSource ID for collection binding

Position.description: Positioning for children of absolute layout containers

WireframeStyleOverride.description: Partial wireframe style for per-node and per-overlay overrides. No fields required — inherits from page.

platform.description: Chrome skin. Defaults to ios for mobile and tablet, web otherwise. Changes chrome only, never which elements exist.

separatorPolicy.description: Shorthand separator policy. auto/divide render parent dividers only when gap is 0; gutters/no dividers win when gap is greater than 0.

separators.description: Draw dividers between sibling children. Only effective when gap is 0.

mode.description: Rendering mode. line = blueprint/schematic. card = greyscale product mock.

density.description: Layout density. comfortable = default spacing. compact = reduced spacing.

explain.description: Emit data-wf-why on every node, explaining its frame decision.

component.description: Primitive component name or reusable component ID

role.description: Semantic role. A known role drives built-in proportions and the frame decision.

surface.description: Explicitly marks a node as a framed surface or forces it to remain content-only.

elevation.description: Card-mode elevation token. Ignored in line mode.

sticky.description: Stays at an edge of its containing scroll area. Put the bar before the content it must stay above.
Makes this top-level region sticky during scroll. top = sticks to top of viewport. bottom = sticks to bottom.

role.description: Semantic role. A known role drives built-in proportions and the frame decision.

surface.description: Force this region to draw a frame, or force it not to.

fields.description: Expected field names for items (informational, used for validation hints)

items.description: Array of plain key-value objects, each containing the primaryKey field

SizingTokens.description: Project-wide overrides for built-in proportions, token name to pixels.

PrimitiveProps_section.description: Generic container. The frame rules decide whether it gets a box.

PrimitiveProps_card.description: Always a framed card, at any nesting depth.

PrimitiveProps_grid.description: Grid layout group. Never framed; its children become framed tiles.

PrimitiveProps_split.description: Side-by-side resizable panes. The panes are framed, the split is not.

PrimitiveProps_form.description: Groups fields and a submit action. Never framed; wrap in a card for a box.

label.description: Accepted alias for text; text wins when both are set.

PrimitiveProps_paragraph.description: Body copy. Without text it renders skeleton lines.

label.description: Accepted alias for text; text wins when both are set.
Accepted alias for text; text wins when both are set.

PrimitiveProps_code.description: Monospaced code block. Set inline: true for an inline run.

PrimitiveProps_badge.description: Badge, pill, chip, tag or status dot. variant is the shape, tone the status.

PrimitiveProps_avatar.description: User avatar from initials or an image; group renders a stack with +n.

PrimitiveProps_icon.description: Font Awesome icon; falls back to a lettered glyph box without the font.

PrimitiveProps_image.description: Image or media placeholder. kind picks the placeholder glyph.

PrimitiveProps_rating.description: Star rating with optional review count.

PrimitiveProps_stat.description: KPI tile: label, value, optional delta/trend/sparkline.

PrimitiveProps_divider.description: Horizontal or vertical rule, optionally labelled.

PrimitiveProps_empty_state.description: Centred empty, error, 404 or offline state with an optional action.

PrimitiveProps_button.description: Button in five variants, three sizes; iconOnly and fab for icon buttons.

PrimitiveProps_input.description: Single-line field. inputType covers search, date, range, otp, colour and more.

PrimitiveProps_select.description: Dropdown field; searchable turns it into a combobox.

PrimitiveProps_choice_group.description: A labelled set of checkboxes or radios in one node.

PrimitiveProps_upload.description: File dropzone, or a plain upload button with variant: button.

PrimitiveProps_picker.description: Native wheel picker. On web this is a select; on iOS and Android it is the spinner.

PrimitiveProps_editor.description: Rich-text editor placeholder with an optional toolbar strip.

PrimitiveProps_tab_bar.description: In-page tabs. Pass tabs[] for one line, or children for full control.

PrimitiveProps_bottom_tab_bar.description: Mobile bottom tab bar, icon above label.

PrimitiveProps_pagination.description: Page controls; variant dots doubles as carousel/onboarding dots.

PrimitiveProps_nav.description: Vertical side navigation; collapsed renders an icon rail.

PrimitiveProps_menu.description: Menu item list for a dropdown or context overlay; the overlay owns the frame.

PrimitiveProps_app_bar.description: Mobile top chrome: leading glyph, title, trailing actions.

PrimitiveProps_action_sheet.description: Native action list for a bottom sheet: choices plus a cancel row.

PrimitiveProps_page_header.description: Page title block: breadcrumb, title, subtitle, actions and tabs.

PrimitiveProps_table.description: Data table with typed columns, selection, sorting and loading/empty states.

PrimitiveProps_list.description: List rows. kind covers plain, avatar, action, file, chat and timeline shapes.

PrimitiveProps_chart.description: Greeked chart placeholder in nine shapes. Deterministic, never random.

label.description: Accepted alias for title; title wins when both are set.

PrimitiveProps_calendar.description: Month, week, day or compact picker grid.

PrimitiveProps_kanban.description: Board of columns; each column is a framed surface, the board is not.

PrimitiveProps_accordion.description: Collapsible rows; set open on the item that starts expanded.

PrimitiveProps_alert.description: Banner or inline alert. Variants differ by glyph, stripe hue and edge weight.
